name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – § 45 – Am 1
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 45. Considers that while the new investment protection chapter replaces outdated bilateral investment treaties and thus brings some procedural improvements to the outdated investor-state dispute settlement mechanisms, it still protects fossil fuel investments and contains commitments going well beyond non-discrimination, which risks damaging the legitimate right of public authorities to regulate; urges the parties to ensure the alignment of investment protection provisions with environmental policies, labour rights and human rights; calls for a swift review of the investment protection chapter in line with Parliament’s recommendations in its resolution of 23 June 2022 on the future of EU international investment policy, such as excluding fossil fuel-related investments from its scope and carving out parties’ climate policies from provisions on investment protection;
